Finance

Easy finance on used cars

Our finance desk helps arrange used-car loans through banks and NBFCs, so you can plan the purchase around an EMI that suits you.

  • Help with the loan paperwork
  • Loan amount and tenure matched to your budget
  • Works alongside exchange value for a lower loan amount
